segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so I pulled up the notes from last week's call. You're looking at 42 full seats for the operations team, plus 15 read-only seats for managers, correct?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's right. We may add three more full seats in Q2, but for launch it's 42 and 15.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. On pricing, the 42 full seats are $86 per seat per month, and the read-only seats are $18. With annual billing, the total comes to $47,376 before tax. That's using the standard annual prepay rate on the pricing sheet.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that's within the range we discussed. Can the invoice be split by cost center? Finance wants 70 percent billed to operations and 30 percent to customer support.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, we can do that on the first invoice. It'll still be one agreement, just two billing lines with the cost centers listed. I can include those codes if you send them over by Friday.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, I have them. Another thing: we need the go-live no later than March 18. Our current reporting process shuts down at the end of that week.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: March 18 works. The implementation plan would be kickoff on February 24, admin training March 5, user training March 12, and then go-live on the 18th. That assumes we get your user list by February 21.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's fine. Legal had one comment on the renewal language. They want the auto-renewal notice period to be 60 days instead of 30.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, we can make it 60 days. That's in our standard fallback language, so I'll put that in the order form and the terms summary.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. If you send the order form today, I can route it for signature tomorrow morning.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: I will send it by 3:00 Pacific today with the seat counts, annual total, March 18 go-live date, split invoice notes, and the 60-day renewal notice. Anything else you want called out?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No, that's it. Send it to me and copy AP, please. The AP alias is on the email thread.
